headline: US and Iran exchange heavy strikes; Iran claims Strait of Hormuz closed
summary: Tehran targets US facilities across the Gulf and closes the vital waterway, while the US hits 140 Iranian military targets.
details: US and Iranian forces have exchanged heavy missile and drone assaults, with Tehran targeting US facilities across the Gulf and claiming to have closed the vital Strait of Hormuz.
US Central Command reported hitting 140 Iranian military targets on Saturday night, while Iranian state media reported explosions in several port cities and the death of an army officer.
In retaliation, Iran's Revolutionary Guards targeted a command-and-control centre in Jordan, a US radar site in Kuwait, refuelling platforms in Oman, and a command facility in Qatar.
The attacks in Qatar injured three people, including a child, due to falling shrapnel. Qatar has stated that Iran is fully legally responsible for the attack.
Iran has vowed to keep the strait closed until the end of US interference in the region, describing the waterway as more important than dozens of atomic bombs.
President Donald Trump rejected claims that the strait is closed, asserting that commercial traffic is flowing and that the US hit Iran very hard.
The escalation follows a failed interim agreement intended to reopen the strait and end the war after 60 days of negotiations.
India reported one of its nationals missing after an attack on the container ship GFS Galaxy off the coast of Oman, where 23 crew members were rescued.
caption:
US and Iran trade heavy missile strikes across the Gulf as Tehran claims to have shut down the Strait of Hormuz.

US and Iranian forces have exchanged heavy missile and drone assaults, with Tehran targeting US facilities across the Gulf and claiming to have closed the vital Strait of Hormuz.

US Central Command reported hitting 140 Iranian military targets on Saturday night, while Iranian state media reported explosions in several port cities and the death of an army officer.

In retaliation, Iran's Revolutionary Guards targeted a command-and-control centre in Jordan, a US radar site in Kuwait, refuelling platforms in Oman, and a command facility in Qatar.

The attacks in Qatar injured three people, including a child, due to falling shrapnel. Qatar has stated that Iran is fully legally responsible for the attack.

Iran has vowed to keep the strait closed until the end of US interference in the region, describing the waterway as more important than dozens of atomic bombs.

President Donald Trump rejected claims that the strait is closed, asserting that commercial traffic is flowing and that the US hit Iran very hard.

The escalation follows a failed interim agreement intended to reopen the strait and end the war after 60 days of negotiations.

India reported one of its nationals missing after an attack on the container ship GFS Galaxy off the coast of Oman, where 23 crew members were rescued.

headline: PM meets International Olympiad gold medalists
summary: The Prime Minister hosted a meeting with students who won gold medals in the International Olympiad Association competitions.
details: The Prime Minister met with a group of students who achieved gold medals in competitions organized by the International Olympiad Association.
During the meeting, the Prime Minister congratulated the students on their exceptional academic achievements and their success on the global stage.
The students shared their experiences and achievements with the Prime Minister, highlighting the importance of education and excellence in science and mathematics.
The Prime Minister emphasized the government's commitment to supporting talented students and fostering a culture of academic excellence in Bangladesh.
